question: Can the validated closed-FRW V=0 U_plus improved-static BFV zero-mode source inhabit the source type of the frozen Starobinsky finite m=2 joint action, or is there an exact model/action/domain/endpoint obstruction?

human_review.missing_typed_object: one source-defined regulated joint relative class whose action, model, endpoint polarization, lapse variables, BFV measure and orientation all share one scope
human_review.bounded_output: one direct source-type compatibility or exact scoped-obstruction verdict
human_review.principal_false_signal: equating the proper-time modulus T of the Starobinsky m=2 action with the Darboux clock coordinate T of the V=0 BFV chart, or silently extending a V=0 cyclic-scalar construction to V(phi) nonzero
human_review.independent_control: reconstruct the Starobinsky canonical momentum pushforward and configuration action independently, then compare model, bulk action, endpoint and source-scope invariants

target_type.model: closed-FRW homogeneous gravity plus Starobinsky scalar potential
target_type.finite_cutoff: m=2 with h=1/2 and equal fixed (a,phi) endpoints
target_type.source_requirement: a derived finite-m2 BFV trajectory source in this same Starobinsky model and endpoint problem

candidate_source_type.model: closed-FRW V=0 on the local U_plus Darboux component

decision_table.condition: all compatibility fields are proved equal in one model and a full finite-m2 BFV trajectory source plus source deformation is present
at least one exact model, action, canonical-pair, clock/lapse, endpoint or finite-source type mismatch is proved while both upstream results retain their own scoped validity
the pinned evidence does not decide compatibility and no exact mismatch witness is available

primary_sources.source: M. Henneaux, C. Teitelboim, and J. D. Vergara, Gauge invariance for generally covariant systems, Nucl. Phys. B 387 (1992) 391-418
primary_sources.not_used_for: equating two repository actions, endpoint problems, or source measures

primary_sources.source: J. A. Garcia, J. D. Vergara, and L. F. Urrutia, BRST-BFV quantization and the Schwinger action principle
primary_sources.used_for: BFV multiplier, ghost and endpoint framework boundary
primary_sources.not_used_for: deriving the repository Starobinsky finite-m2 source

primary_sources.source: E. Witten, Analytic Continuation Of Chern-Simons Theory, arXiv:1001.2933v4
primary_sources.not_used_for: selecting an ICE source, gauge, chain, or global intersection coefficient
